save_mlx_tensors_to_bytes: save MLX tensors as a dictionary to raw bytes in safetensors format with optional metadata
save_file_mlx_tensors: save MLX tensors to a safetensors file on disk with optional metadata
load_mlx_tensors_from_bytes: load safetensors data from raw bytes into MLX mx.array tensors
load_mlx_tensors_from_file: load a safetensors file directly into MLX mx.array tensors by filename
convert_between_mlx_and_numpy: convert MLX mx.array tensors to numpy arrays and back
